evidence.factoryPathAuthFinding: get_or_create_user_lockbox fails with Error(Auth, InvalidAction) because the nested Lockb0x.initialize calls require_auth on the USER address, which does not sign the server-side tx. The provisioner therefore uses the direct deploy+initialize fallback (operator = Deployer). True user-owned lockboxes require the device to co-sign (fee-bump model, P4).
